next:wr:284.hint: 彼が辞任するといううわさだ
next:wr:284.answer: Rumor has it that he will resign.
next:wr:284.fullSentence: Rumor has it that he will resign.
next:wr:284.explanation: Rumor has it that ~『〜といううわさだ』。

next:wr:286.hint: この靴は好きではない。他のものを見せてください(複数)
next:wr:286.answer: I don't like these shoes. Show me some other ones.
next:wr:286.fullSentence: I don't like these shoes. Show me some other ones.
next:wr:286.explanation: ones=前に出た複数の可算名詞(不特定のもの)を受ける代名詞。

next:wr:288.hint: ここの物価は田舎の物価より高い(複数名詞の代用)
next:wr:288.answer: The prices here are higher than those in the countryside.
next:wr:288.fullSentence: The prices here are higher than those in the countryside.
next:wr:288.explanation: those=前に出た複数名詞の反復を避ける代用語。『人々』の意味でも使われる。
next:wr:288.relatedInfo: 単数名詞の代用はthatを使う。

next:wr:290.hint: 鍵をなくしたが、後でそれ(その同じ鍵)を見つけた
next:wr:290.answer: I lost my key, but I found it later.
next:wr:290.fullSentence: I lost my key, but I found it later.
next:wr:290.explanation: it=特定のもの・すでに述べたものそのものを指す代名詞。
next:wr:290.relatedInfo: one(不特定の同種)との対比。

next:wr:292.hint: 彼が謝って初めて彼女は彼を許した
next:wr:292.answer: It was not until he apologized that she forgave him.
next:wr:292.fullSentence: It was not until he apologized that she forgave him.
next:wr:292.explanation: It is not until S or O that SV『SやOして初めて〜した』。
next:wr:292.relatedInfo: not untilを強調構文で表した形。

next:wr:294.hint: あなたが欲しいのは何ですか
next:wr:294.answer: What is it that you want?
next:wr:294.fullSentence: What is it that you want?
next:wr:294.explanation: What is it that ~?『〜なのは何ですか』。疑問詞Whatを強調する構文。
next:wr:294.relatedInfo: 疑問詞の強調構文は日常会話でもよく使われる。

next:wr:296.hint: 両方とも正しいというわけではない(部分否定)
next:wr:296.answer: Not both of the answers are correct; one of them is wrong.
next:wr:296.fullSentence: Not both of the answers are correct; one of them is wrong.
next:wr:296.explanation: not both『両方とも〜というわけではない』(部分否定)。

next:wr:298.hint: (2つのうち)どちらも正しくない
next:wr:298.answer: Neither of the two answers is correct.
next:wr:298.fullSentence: Neither of the two answers is correct.
next:wr:298.explanation: neither『(2つのうち)どちらも〜ない』。
next:wr:298.relatedInfo: 3つ以上の場合はnone/not anyを使う。

next:wr:300.hint: 全員が試験に合格したというわけではない(部分否定)
next:wr:300.answer: Not all of the students passed the exam; some failed.
next:wr:300.fullSentence: Not all of the students passed the exam; some failed.
next:wr:300.explanation: not all『全部が〜というわけではない』(部分否定)。

next:wr:302.hint: (3人以上のうち)誰も答えを知らなかった
next:wr:302.answer: None of the students knew the answer.
next:wr:302.fullSentence: None of the students knew the answer.
next:wr:302.explanation: none/not any『(3つ以上のうち)どれも〜ない』。

next:wr:304.hint: この車を売って別の車を買うつもりだ
next:wr:304.answer: I'm going to sell this car and get another one.
next:wr:304.fullSentence: I'm going to sell this car and get another one.
next:wr:304.explanation: another『別のもう一つ』(不特定の単数)。
next:wr:304.relatedInfo: another one=another car(繰り返しを避けている)。

next:wr:306.hint: 客は次から次へと入ってきた
next:wr:306.answer: Customers kept coming in one after another.
next:wr:306.fullSentence: Customers kept coming in one after another.
next:wr:306.explanation: one after another『次から次へと、続々と』。
next:wr:306.relatedInfo: one A after anotherは名詞を伴う形。

next:wr:308.hint: このプロジェクトを終えるのにもう2年必要だ
next:wr:308.answer: I need another two years to finish this project.
next:wr:308.fullSentence: I need another two years to finish this project.
next:wr:308.explanation: another+数詞+複数名詞『もう〜(の期間・数)』。
next:wr:308.relatedInfo: anotherは単数用法だが、数詞+複数名詞をひとまとまりと見て使う。

next:wr:310.answer: I have two pens. One is red, and the other is blue.
next:wr:310.fullSentence: I have two pens. One is red, and the other is blue.
next:wr:310.explanation: the other『(2つのうち)残りの1つ』(特定)。
next:wr:310.relatedInfo: othersとの違いはthe(特定)がついている点。

next:wr:312.hint: 一人は医者、もう一人は教師、残りは学生だ(3者)
next:wr:312.answer: I have three brothers. One is a doctor, another is a teacher, and the others are students.
next:wr:312.fullSentence: I have three brothers. One is a doctor, another is a teacher, and the others are students.
next:wr:312.explanation: One, another, the others『(3者以上で)一人、もう一人、残り全部』。
next:wr:312.relatedInfo: the othersは残り全部(特定・複数)。

next:wr:314.hint: 彼の両親とも(その計画に賛成した)
next:wr:314.answer: Both his parents agreed to the plan.
next:wr:314.fullSentence: Both his parents agreed to the plan.
next:wr:314.explanation: both his parents『彼の両親とも』。bothは所有格の前に置ける。
next:wr:314.relatedInfo: both of his parents とも言い換え可能。

next:wr:316.hint: 6時間毎にこの薬を飲む必要がある
next:wr:316.answer: You need to take this medicine every six hours.
next:wr:316.fullSentence: You need to take this medicine every six hours.
next:wr:316.explanation: every+数詞+複数名詞『〜毎に』(＝every sixth hour)。
next:wr:316.relatedInfo: every other dayなど頻度表現の仲間。

next:wr:318.hint: 私たちの誰も何を言うべきかわからなかった
next:wr:318.answer: None of us knew what to say.
next:wr:318.fullSentence: None of us knew what to say.
next:wr:318.explanation: none『誰も/何も〜ない』(全体否定)。
next:wr:318.relatedInfo: none of usのように可算・不可算どちらにも使える。

next:wr:320.hint: 彼は独力で(一人で)そのプロジェクトを終えた
next:wr:320.answer: He finished the project by himself.
next:wr:320.fullSentence: He finished the project by himself.
next:wr:320.relatedInfo: for oneself『自分の力で』との違いに注意(byは孤独、forは自分自身のために)。

next:wr:322.hint: 彼女は独力でその事業を営んでいる
next:wr:322.answer: She runs the business on her own.
next:wr:322.fullSentence: She runs the business on her own.

next:wr:324.hint: 彼女はそのケーキを丸ごと独り占めしたかった
next:wr:324.answer: She wanted to have the whole cake to herself.
next:wr:324.fullSentence: She wanted to have the whole cake to herself.
next:wr:324.explanation: have ~ to oneself『~を独り占めする』。
next:wr:324.relatedInfo: keep ~ to oneself(秘密にしておく)と混同しないこと。

next:wr:326.hint: 彼女は思わず笑ってしまった
next:wr:326.answer: She laughed in spite of herself.
next:wr:326.fullSentence: She laughed in spite of herself.
next:wr:326.explanation: in spite of oneself『思わず』。自分の意志に反してという意味。
next:wr:326.relatedInfo: in spite of A(Aにもかかわらず)のAに再帰代名詞が入った形。

next:wr:328.hint: 彼は怒りで我を忘れていた
next:wr:328.answer: He was beside himself with rage.
next:wr:328.fullSentence: He was beside himself with rage.
next:wr:328.explanation: beside oneself (with rage)『(怒りなどで)我を忘れて』。
next:wr:328.relatedInfo: with joy(喜びで)など感情の種類を変えて使える。

next:wr:330.hint: このパンフレットは無料で手に入る
next:wr:330.answer: You can get this pamphlet for nothing.
next:wr:330.fullSentence: You can get this pamphlet for nothing.
next:wr:330.relatedInfo: forは対価がないことを表す。

next:wr:332.hint: 彼はちょっとした音楽家だ(どことなく音楽家らしいところがある)
next:wr:332.answer: He is something of a musician.
next:wr:332.fullSentence: He is something of a musician.
next:wr:332.explanation: be something of a A『ちょっとしたAだ』。
next:wr:332.relatedInfo: 完全な専門家ではないが、それらしい面がある、というニュアンス。
